projectsPage.title: Projects
projectsPage.subtitle: Things I've founded, built, and kept running in production.
projectsPage.muroomDesc: University-backed music-studio search platform, founded in a team of five. Owned backend search & all AWS infra: PostGIS viewport queries, 13 dynamic filters; Terraform prod + dev at ~$150/mo. Beta live in 3 weeks.
projectsPage.fitnessDesc: Fitness-platform backend and both its web frontends, solo-built. Multi-tenant API: 206 endpoints, 22 domains, one OAuth2 scope-based account system serving 4 client surfaces. ~590× faster analytics (measured), −58% AWS cost.
projectsPage.siteDesc: This blog. Next.js + Supabase on free tiers, custom block editor with markdown shortcuts, view counts and comments on Postgres.
projectsPage.newsClassifierDesc: 2-month news-classification pipeline: React/Redux frontend, FastAPI model management, multiprocessing + SSE. 3rd place at Hecto Group showcase.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.p1: I'm Tae Hwan Kim, Monte to most people. I'm a software engineer, backend by preference and full-stack in practice, and I like owning the whole path: Terraform and CI/CD at the bottom, Spring Boot APIs in the middle, Next.js consoles on top.
aboutPage.p2: Before software I wrote music: released tracks, film scores, ad music. That's what led me to found Muroom, a studio search platform for musicians. I still think building products is closer to composing than engineering textbooks admit.
aboutPage.nowBody: Building the fitness platform at Moty in Seoul. Moving to the UK in October 2026 on a Youth Mobility Scheme visa, so no sponsorship is needed. Open to software engineering roles (backend / full-stack) in London.
